curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Kumasi.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR1917487 && mv data/SRR1917487_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR1917487_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Kumasi. Antigenic formula should match 30:z10:e,n,z15. Accept antigenic formula with or without bracket notation around O:5.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST2302. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.
